rationale: Amdahl's law states that the overall speedup obtainable by optimizing a component is limited by the fraction of execution time that component occupies. The principle applies this logic to LLM post-training rollout: because rollout dominates execution time, optimizing it is the primary lever for reducing end-to-end cost. The meta-principle provides the general performance-bound rationale, while the principle supplies the workload-specific instantiation.
